packageRules.description: The Dagster libraries must match the host webserver and daemon (greco-home-builder, dagster/dagster-k8s). One grouped PR, never automerged: merge it by hand together with the host image PR.

Keep the Chainguard builder (python:latest-dev) and runtime (python:latest) in lockstep across all package Dockerfiles — one PR, never desynced, so the venv copied from the builder always matches the runtime Python.
